# Incident Response

## Suspicious Process Access to LSASS Memory

**Technique:** [T1003.001](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1003/001/) · **Rule:** [`T1003.001_lsass_memory_access`](../T1003.001_lsass_memory_access/)

| Role | Action |
|---|---|
| SOC L2 | Pivot on the source process: parent tree, .dmp files written nearby (Sysmon 11), outbound transfers, and logons by accounts active on the host |
| Incident response | Treat as credential theft: isolate the host, reset every credential used on it since boot, hunt for reuse of those accounts |

### Evidence to collect
- ProcessAccess event with GrantedAccess and CallTrace
- Process tree of SourceImage
- Any dump file and its hash
- Logon sessions on the host since last reboot

### Containment
1. Isolate the host
2. Reset credentials of every account that logged on to the host since last reboot, including service accounts
3. Hunt for reuse of those credentials across the estate
